28.description: This feature vector activates strongly on tokens representing vowels and vowel-like characters across multiple scripts and encodings.

127.description: This vector is related to subword tokens and fragments frequently occurring in Hindi and multilingual text processing.

85.description: This feature vector activates on common linguistic suffixes and word fragments across multiple languages.

71.description: This vector activates for Hindi consonant-vowel dependent glyph combinations and non-standard transliterated text fragments.

164.description: This feature vector activates strongly on subwords and characters from the Hindi Devanagari script.

10.description: This feature vector activates strongly on words and subwords containing Hindi dental and retroflex sibilant sounds, particularly forms of the demonstrative pronoun "this" (is/iss).

175.description: This feature vector represents common Devanagari (Hindi) script subwords, characters, and linguistic suffixes.

63.description: This vector is related to Latin and Cyrillic morphological suffixes and characters representing the 'u' and 'um' sounds across different scripts.

99.description: This vector activates on common Hindi words and subwords starting with the vowel 'ए' or containing related devanagari vowel and consonant combinations.

177.description: This vector activates for Hindi dependent vowel signs and consonant-vowel combinations.
